description: Register 1 (TESTREG, variant 10) delivers VALUE (member 1001, variable 101) in 2020. Three codebooks in the SOS fetch layout (code,label,label_en,parent_code,valid_from,valid_to) and two in the plain code,label layout: tree.csv, a tree under two roots whose child rows come before their parents, plus one parentless code; flat.csv, whose parent_code cells name chapter 01, which is no code of the book (KS87-P's shape); broken.csv, whose code 12 names parent 9, which is no code of the book; prefix.csv, an LKF-shaped book nesting by code prefix (län 01, kommun 0114, församlingar 011401 and 018001, whose kommun 0180 is no code of the book); badprefix.csv, a prefix book with a code 011 of an undeclared width and a code 0201 whose prefix 02 is no code of the book.
